response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID)

assumptions.assumption: Elevated means UA > 3.9 (strictly greater than the cutoff).
APTT - PT is computed per record, so records missing either value are skipped for that average. Patients whose per-patient average is NULL are ignored in the final averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute the average APTT and the average PT separately per patient, each over its own non-missing records, then subtract. This differs from the primary query when a record has only one of the two values.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt - avg_pt) AS avg_of_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT) AS avg_aptt, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID)
